partner_result.applied_at: the exact partial-receiver inequalities ||B_t||_2^2 <= 32*pi^4(K_H K_L K_V/s)|t| and, in the harmonic family, ||B_t||_2 <= 8*pi^2 c^(-1/4)|t|^(1/2)

new_result.statement: For Q=2(sH+aZ)L+V^2 with H independent of the leaf triplet and scalar density caps K_H,K_L,K_V, the partner's mixed (xi,q) receiver B_t is exactly 4*pi*|t| times the Fourier transform of g_t(v)=p_V(v)E[exp(i2atZL)psi_H(2stL)|V=v], and ||g_t||_2^2 <= pi K_H K_L K_V/(s|t|). Hence ||B_t||_2^2 <=32*pi^4(K_HK_LK_V/s)|t|, uniformly in a=sqrt(rho) and with arbitrary dependence among Z,L,V.
new_result.scope: supporting theorem for the exact near-coloop rank-three survivor; does not prove the L-infinity endpoint

barrier: The remaining one-dimensional Fresnel pairing phi_Q(t)=int exp(itv^2)g_t(v)dv cannot be controlled from ||g_t||_1, ||g_t||_infinity and ||g_t||_2=O(t^-1/2) alone; h_T=T^-1 1_[0,T] exp(-iTv^2) matches those scales and has pairing equal to one. This is only a proof-interface obstruction, not an admissible QFORM counterexample.
next_step: Exploit the original product-linear provenance inside g_t, beyond its L1/L2/Linfinity norms, to rule out quadratic anti-phase-alignment and close the minority/two-sheet endpoint uniformly in rho.
